$comment: +++===+++ 2026-10-14 — Hasan Alizada — HAAL-014. First atom: Week A/B label (FR-CAL-23). Needed on the client (offline header) and on the server (exports, reminders), hence two implementations against one contract.
purpose: Returns the Week A/B label of a date: weeks are counted from a user-chosen anchor week, so the result stays correct across year boundaries and 53-week years.

anchor.description: Any date inside the week the user marked as the first label (A).

week_start.description: First day of week: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday … 6 = Saturday (user setting).

weeks_from_anchor.description: Whole weeks between the start of the anchor week and the start of the date's week; negative before the anchor.

invariants: week start of a date = the latest day on or before the date whose weekday equals week_start
weeks_from_anchor = (weekStart(date) - weekStart(anchor)) in days / 7, always an integer
index = weeks_from_anchor mod 2 using the mathematical (non-negative) modulo
all dates of one week (by week_start) get the same label
ISO week numbers are never used for parity
